pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: LORD SHIONO AGREED TO ASSUME THE FAMILY'S DEBT.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: THE MASTER OF THIS HOUSE, LORD YOSHIAKI, IS A GOOD MAN, BUT HE'S NOT VERY COMPETENT AT MANAGING FINANCES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: RUMOR HAS IT THAT HIS WIFE, LADY MIZUE, KEEPS HIM ON A TIGHT LEASH, TOO.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WITH LORD YOSHIKUNI BEING THE WAY HE IS..

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: IT'S NO GREAT WONDER THAT THE OLD MASTER WOULD CHOOSE THE YOUNGER BROTHER, LORD YOSHIAKI, AS HIS HEIR, BUT

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: MISS SATO WILL YELL AT ME AGAIN IF I KEEP GOING ON LIKE THIS.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: TO REPAY YOU FOR THE CHAT,

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: OH! WHAT IS IT, WHAT IS IT?!
